system.description:
GRIMWARD

Disguises, transformations and false names do not change the subject of an investigation.
Your Inquisition remains attached to a creature when it changes appearance, assumes another form, uses a disguise or adopts another identity.
Whenever your Subject uses an Illusion, polymorph effect or mundane disguise to conceal its identity from you, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to checks made to recognise or penetrate that disguise.

Prerequisites Level 4

Works automatically: +2 circumstance is offered on checks with the book's wording.

conditionals.label: Unbroken Pursuit
conditionals.scope: Checks to recognise or penetrate an Illusion, polymorph effect or mundane disguise your Subject uses to conceal its identity
